statement: The United States and Iran, directly or through the mediating states of Qatar, Oman, or Pakistan named in current shuttle diplomacy, announce a ceasefire, truce, or negotiated framework ending active hostilities in the ongoing Iran war, with that announcement first reported between 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-10.
resolution: At least two independently owned wire services, or the US State Department and the Iranian foreign ministry both, confirm a ceasefire, truce, or framework agreement ending active US-Iran hostilities was announced within the stated window, checked by 2026-10-13.
failure_condition: No ceasefire, truce, or negotiated framework ending active US-Iran hostilities is announced and confirmed by two independent sources within the window; continued strikes, continued talks without agreement, or a unilateral pause not confirmed by both sides all count as a MISS.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

failure_condition: No confirmed Russian-origin strike lands on NATO member territory within the window; verbal warnings, sabotage allegations short of a kinetic strike, or strikes confined to Ukrainian territory all count as a MISS.
